fusions.name: Called Plague
fusions.desc: After a 1.5 second incantation, looses 5 swarms in a spread, each one dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Recited Bite
fusions.desc: Sends a single named locust at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 7 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach. Holds up to 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Spoken Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Prepared Syllables
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
